description: Curated public-domain fairy tales from named Project Gutenberg editions. Episodes are original abridged retellings; one edition is selected per tale.
rotation: Sequential; no repeats until the whole enabled queue has been completed, then a new cycle begins without immediately repeating the last tale.

stories.title: The Goose-Girl

stories.synopsis: A princess is sent to marry a distant prince, but her maid forces her to exchange clothes and identities. The princess becomes a goose girl, while the maid claims the royal place.
